title: A Computational Approach to Search in Visual Working Memory
authors: Aditi Singh, Andra Mihali, Wen-Chuang Chou, Wei Ji Ma
caption_short: Task design: fixation (1000 ms), memory array of 2 to 8 coloured discs (100 ms), delay (1000 ms), then a probe display in which two discs are replaced by grey circles and the target colour is shown at the centre; the participant clicks the location that held it.
